useCase.name: End employment on the school's decision, with notice or immediately, and run the same exit and handover
useCase.featureRef: 12.18 Termination or dismissal of a member of staff

intent.name: termination.open
intent.summary: Open a termination case with the reason and the supporting record it rests on. One step, and it takes effect only when approved.
routesHere: open a termination case for this employee, the warnings are on file

routesHere.text: is mulazim ke khilaf termination ka case khol do
routesHere.gloss: open a termination case against this employee

routesHere.text: barkhastagi ka case banao, record laga hua hai
routesHere.gloss: open a dismissal case, the record is attached

routesHere.text: mulazim ko nikalna hai, wajah aur record hai
routesHere.gloss: we need to dismiss the employee, the reason and the record are ready

routesElsewhere.note: A resignation is the employee's own act from their own portal. A termination is the school's decision (BR-12, UC-12-17 BR-1).
An employee cannot open a termination against themselves or anybody else. Only the School Admin or the Principal can (BR-12, E3).

request.gloss: we will attach the record later

routesElsewhere.note: A termination with no supporting record cannot be defended afterwards, and the case is not opened without one (BR-1, E1).

steps.note: One step. A termination records the reason and the supporting record it rests on — a decision with no record behind it cannot be defended afterwards (BR-1).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A missing reason, a missing supporting record, and an employee attempting to open a case are all refused.
plan.atomicity: One write: the case, its reason and its supporting record together or not at all. Nothing happens to the employee — they stay active, and the case takes effect only when it is approved (BR-2). A termination case is never deleted; one that is not approved stays on record as returned or withdrawn (BR-11).

parameters.name: staff_id

parameters.name: reason

parameters.name: supporting_record_id

resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the documents held against that employee.

parameters.notes: The warnings, findings or evidence the case rests on (BR-1, E1). Uploaded on the screen and named here — a file does not travel in a plan, and a termination with no record behind it cannot be defended.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: employee_notified

errors.note: A decision with no record behind it cannot be defended afterwards (BR-1).

errors.meaning: An employee attempted to open a termination.
errors.note: Only the School Admin or the Principal can (BR-12).

planningRules.rule: Never compose the reason. It is read back in any dispute about the dismissal (BR-1), and words a planner wrote would be the school's stated grounds for ending somebody's employment.
Never open a case without the supporting record. E1 is BR-1 working — the evidence is a file attached on the screen, and a case a plan opened without it is a dismissal with nothing behind it.
Never suggest a resignation as a way around a termination. They are different records with different meanings, and one is the employee's own act (BR-12, UC-12-17 BR-1).
Say plainly that nothing has happened to the employee yet. The case takes effect when it is approved, and they are told then (BR-2, BR-4).
Report that the case is permanent. A termination case is never deleted; one that is not approved stays on record as returned or withdrawn (BR-11).
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A termination case is never deleted (BR-11). One that will not proceed is returned unapproved and stays on the record.

intent.name: termination.effect.set
intent.summary: Set whether the termination runs with notice or takes immediate effect. One step, and immediate means the leaving date is the date of approval.

routesHere.gloss: make this termination take immediate effect

routesHere.text: notice ke saath karo, ek mahine ka
notice period rakhna hai ya foran
routesHere.gloss: should it be with notice or immediate

request.text: handover ki fikr baad mein karenge
request.gloss: we will worry about the handover later

routesElsewhere.note: An immediate termination still cannot leave a class unstaffed. The checklist is worked the same day and anything unassigned is escalated at once (BR-9, E6).

steps.note: One step. With notice, a notice period runs exactly as for a resignation; with immediate effect the leaving date is the date of approval and no notice period runs (BR-3).

plan.atomicity: One write: the effect, the notice period where one applies, and the audit entry together or not at all. Nothing takes effect until the case is approved (BR-2). Where the effect is immediate the School Admin works the handover checklist, since the departing employee is not there to (BR-5) — and anything unassigned is escalated at once rather than over a notice period (BR-9).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is set. Ask whether it runs with notice or takes immediate effect — with notice, a notice period runs as for a resignation and the handover has time; immediate means their classes need covering the same day.

intent.name: termination.approve
intent.summary: Approve a termination, which ends the employment and tells the employee. The configured approver only, one step, and there is no route back.

routesHere.text: case manzoor hai, lagu kar do
routesHere.gloss: the case is accepted, put it into effect

routesElsewhere.note: There is no such route. The decision is final (BR-2, E10).
The exit path is the same as a resignation from the handover onward (BR-10).

steps.note: One step, and it is not reversible. The employee is notified of the decision, the reason and the leaving date — a person dismissed without being told why has no way to respond (BR-4).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. An approval by a role the configuration does not name is refused by the API.
plan.atomicity: One write, atomic in itself: the approval, the leaving date, the handover checklist and the notification to the employee together or not at all. Where the effect is immediate the leaving date is today, the access goes today, and the checklist is worked today by the School Admin (BR-3, BR-5, BR-6, BR-9). **There is no route that reverses this** — the decision is final (BR-2, E10).

parameters.name: termination_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No termination case matches at a state that allows this.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with the employee, the effect and the status.

parameters.name: branch_id

fields.name: approved_by

fields.name: employee_notified

fields.name: handover_worked_by

errors.meaning: The School Admin approved where the Principal is configured.
No effect has been set on the case.
errors.note: With notice or immediate decides the leaving date (BR-3).

planningRules.rule: Never approve a case the actor opened where the configuration names somebody else. E4 is BR-2 working, and this ends somebody's employment.
Say plainly that there is no route back. An approved termination is not reversed and the decision is final (BR-2, E10) — this is the last moment at which anything can be reconsidered.
Report that the employee is told the reason. A person dismissed without being told why has no way to respond (BR-4), and the notification is part of the same act.
Report the handover checklist and, on an immediate termination, that it is worked today. An immediate termination still cannot leave a class unstaffed (BR-9, E6).
Never chain a reassignment. Each item goes to a named person who can take it, and a class handed to somebody already teaching then is still unstaffed (UC-12-17 E5).

reversal.statement: There is no route that reverses an approved termination. The decision is final (BR-2, E10). The controller must not attempt a compensating call — the employee has been told.

resolvedPlans.context: Principal, Johar Town branch, effect immediate, nine timetable slots held.
resolvedPlans.outcome: Approved. The leaving date is today, the access goes today, and the employee is told the decision, the reason and the date (PR-3). Report the nine items now with the School Admin and escalated at once (PR-4) — those classes need covering this afternoon. There is no route back from here (PR-2).
